content: Làkwikilà
Làkwikilà là kam mukal anà undiir awà unsà làkyän, mbwo muyöb ndandaa a undiir mpa bàfàman.
U mbwo a la, andweer bàwɛl imbäl aŋàbwaŋ.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, bi ikyàyöb naa mɛɛn manswà màŋàyöŋà u mbwo a ndaa a Nzam, abun, indiir byàfàmɛnà u mii byàfàfà unsà indiir mpa byàfàmɛnà.

U mbwo a làkwikilà, Abɛl kàpɛ ibɔɔn aŋàbwaŋ akà Nzam kyàŋàsöön kyà Kayin. Ntɔn kya, Nzam kun'twey wàbalàbal, anà kun'tɛɛl imbäl nde ŋakwo ntɔn an'kab ande. Ntɔn la, nde wàmutɛɛnà tii ŋàbà itàkal naa nde kàkyàkwà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Ɛnɔk bàkyer un'swaam ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aman ukwà. Bàfàfun'man anki, ntɔn Nzam kàkyer un'swaam. Kusà a nswaam ande, nde kàwɛl imbäl naa Nzam kàkyer un'kyey.
Kyekà, ukɔɔn làkwikilà, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mupà Nzam un'sak, ntɔn mbuur afàsin tsütsü apà Nzam, akyer asà làkwikilà naa Nde wà paa anà Nde afàpà làfur akà baar bàfun'leŋ.

U mbwo a làkwikilà, Nɔwà kàwem ngweey a Nzam ntɔn indiir mpa aŋàtàman. Nde ya kàwɛl anki asànaa un'tääm, waa kàtöŋ an'swà ntɔn ywar ande làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈. Abun, nde kàtsüül mɛɛn ntaaŋàmbar, waa kàbulà ŋakwal a balàbal làfàyà u mbwo a làkwikilà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Abàlam kàkyey làbeel a Nzam awà kun'swɛŋ mukyà nsi ayà kàlàkàwal nde kwal, nde kàkyen ukɔɔn ayöb naa nde ken ukyà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, nde kàkàbwaay asànaa ungyey u mɛɛn a ilää. Nde kàbwaayà u ntɛn asànaa Isak anà Yakɔb sye, baar bàkäl unsà ilää nsil kya.
Ntɔn nde kàdilà bul làkäl anà in'bään a ngwal amyà kàyöŋà anà kàtöŋ Nzam ŋakwo.
U mbwo a làkwikilà Saal, nde ŋakwo sye, itàkal naa mbul ande yàkäl yàŋàlyaaŋ, nde kàbulà wàŋàkwo mubɔr, ntɔn Nzam awà kàpɛ ilää aki wà wàlää.
Kyakin sye, fà akà mbuur mwɛy mpɛl, awà kàkäl aŋànün tsütsü mukwà, bàbör un'kàbɔ a baar asànaa mbwaar a du, asànaa an'sɛŋ a làbuŋ a ɛwà, mpa ban'kwo mutaŋ.
Yà unsà làkwikilà, baar abà banswà bàkü ukɔɔn awal indiir bapɛ ilää, wɛɛ ba bya bàmɛn mpɛl anà bàpɛ bya mbɔr ukwɛl. Anà ba bàyöb naa ba bà angyey anà alyaaŋ u mɛɛn.
Ntɔn, baar bàfàtɛn abwɛy, ba bàfàswaŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa ba bàmuleŋ nsi.
Yàlàkal naa ba bàfàyɔbà anà nkyɛɛr nsi bàlwomà ba, ba bàlàwal ipöl mufurà kwo.
Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ, ba bàkäl anà ngyal mukal anà nsi yan'söön ubwaŋ, iswaŋà naa nsi a Du. Kyakin, nswɛn yatɛy naa ba bàbeel Nzam naa Nzam aba ntɔn nde kalɔ̈ɔ̈n bul mwɛy.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, umpal bun'sii, Abàlam kàkäb Isak, mwan baal ande mwɛy mpɛl, asànaa ibɔɔn, nde mbuur kàwɛl ilää,
anà kàtɛn Nzam a nde naa: « Bɔr angye làsàkal làmbɔɔn u mbwo a Isak. »
Nde kàmɛn naa Nzam we anà ikɔ̈b muwiiy un'kü, lalan Nzam kun'fuur nde mwan ande anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ asànaa kye anà ikɔk a ndaa, ndaa a ngwiiyà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà sye, Isak kàsaak Yakɔb anà Isawu muyilà ndaa isàyà ungö.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Yakɔb, kusà a nkweel ande, kàsaak baan a Yɔsɛfi umwɛy umwɛy. Nde kàtsüüm u nswɛŋ a unsɔk ande, waa kàkömà Nzam.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Yɔsɛfi u ntsüü a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande, kàkyään ntoo a baan a Isàlɛl anà kàpɛ nswɛɛŋ naa ba bàsàkyer aben ntɔn in'kwo ande.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Mɔsɛ, ungö a mböör ande, aböör ande bun'yee ngɔn tär. Ntɔn bàmɛn ba ntwɛn a mwan aba, ba bàmɛn anki bɔɔmà mubɛy un'kɔɔn a mfum.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Mɔsɛ, mpal kàbulà nde undweer, kàtön bun'beel mwan baal a mwan un'kaar a Falàwɔ.
Nde kàkwen muman mpay mbwo mwɛy anà un'sɛŋ a Nzam, akwànaa mukal kà un'sak ntɔn taaŋ làmwɛy là man'be.
Nde kàmɛn naa muman nswɛn asànaa Klistɔ yà un'naaŋ aŋàsöön ntal akwànaa in'naaŋ a Ngipiti, ntɔn mii ande myàkäl muler bweel alà làyà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, nde kàlwomà u Ngipiti ukɔɔn aman bɔɔmà a un'fur a nkyɛl a mfum. Nde kàkäl aŋàtsim asànaa nde kàmɛnà Nzam mpa bàfàman.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, nde kàswaal Pak anà kàswɛŋ musir an'kil kà ibeenà a ndwà ntɔn un'dwää ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aba baan abaal a nswɛm bà Isàlɛl.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, ba bàtsül ngyäl a wɛŋwɛŋ asànaa u mɛɛn aŋàyɔm. Wɛɛ umpal bàsii baar a Ngipiti mutsul, ba bàkyer aminà.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, ibä a Yɛlikɔ byàkyer abwà, ungö a un'sɛŋ muywolà bya ilä nsambwaar.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, Rayab, un'kaar a pasàsɛ, kàkü anki anà baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà, ntɔn nde kàwɛl aseey unsà ubwaŋ.
Ininà mɛ in'fàtɛn? Taaŋ làkyer ayan'kɔ̈ɔ̈n muyääm pànsi pànsi ntɔn Ngidyɔn, Barak, Samsɔn, Zeftɛ, David, Sàmwel anà aŋangɔɔm,
u mbwo a làkwikilà ba bàwɛl iböŋ udu a imwol mbɔɔn, bàsyääl balàbal unsà isal, bàwɛl indiir bapɛɛl ilää, bàdübà min a ngɔɔm,
bàdim ngwal a mbaa, bàsɔrà u mpɔr a an'kɔm, bàbulà aŋangwal ungö a gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, bàbulà aŋangwal unsà ità, bàbɔ̈ŋ aŋità angyey.
U mbwo a làkwikilà, akaar bàfàman akü aba u mbwo a ngwiiyà, waa bafuur abà. Bamwɛy bamɛɛy nkwaaŋ. Ba bàkyer atɔn naa batsuuŋ, ntɔn ba bàwɛl ngwiiyà aŋàsöön ubwaŋ.
Bumwɛy bàkyer atoo, bakäm an'füm, babäm in'siŋ, waa batɔɔm u bɔlokà.
Bumwɛy sye bàkyer atà in'kul, batsütsül a si, badwä a kɔm. Ba bàkyer ayöö, bàbwäärà ibaan a in'kɔk itàkal ibaan a ntab. Ba batsüŋ indiir mbɔɔn, bamɛɛy nkwaaŋ, bapɛ mpay.
Ntɔn mɛɛn màfàkal anki ubwaŋ ntɔn ba. Ba bàbulà muyöö u nsye a ipɔl, u myɔŋ, uboo a mɔɔ anà u mfwoo a mɛɛn.
Ba banswà, isàkal naa ba bàwɛl imbäl aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn làkwikilà aba, wɛɛ ba bàsàwal anki indiir kapɛ Nzam ilää.
Ntɔn Nzam kàbön undiir aŋàsöön ntɔn bi, ba bàlàkɔlà anki bàŋàkwo ukɔɔn bi.
